title: Concrete Cadence
description: A raw, bass-led trap-rap cut at 140 BPM: a broken 808 kick carves wide pockets for an imagined rap cadence while a gliding sub bass rolls underneath. Perlin-driven hat rolls thicken and thin across the arrangement as the low end darkens and reopens, building from a stripped intro to a dense, snarling peak before stripping back out.
code:
setcpm(140/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.1),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(220).gain(0.55),
    s("hh*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain(perlin.range(0.2,0.45)).hpf(6000).cut(1)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.1),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.55),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(240,520)).gain(0.6),
    s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR808").gain(perlin.range(0.18,0.5)).hpf(5500).cut(1).degradeBy(0.15)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.15),
    s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.7),
    s("~ cp ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.5),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").add(note(perlin.range(-0.4,0.4))).s("sine").lpf(420).gain(0.62),
    s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR808").gain(perlin.range(0.15,0.55)).hpf(5000).cut(1).ply("<1 1 2 1>"),
    s("~ ~ ~ oh").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.4).cut(1)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(180,420)).gain(0.6),
    s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR808").gain(perlin.range(0.1,0.35)).hpf(7000).cut(1).degradeBy(0.3),
    s("rim ~ ~ rim").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.45)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.2),
    s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.72),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.55),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").add(note(perlin.range(-0.5,0.5))).s("sine").lpf(perlin.range(300,650)).gain(0.65),
    s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR808").gain(perlin.range(0.18,0.6)).hpf(4500).cut(1).ply("<1 2 2 4>").degradeBy(0.1),
    s("~ ~ oh ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.42).cut(1),
    s("lt ~ ~ mt").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.4).every(4, x => x.ply(2))
  )],
  [12, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.05),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(sine.slow(12).range(200,300)).gain(0.55),
    s("hh*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain(perlin.range(0.15,0.35)).hpf(6500).cut(1)
  )]
)
